subject: Problem ( RATLLE Down) : Basic of summary type in explore Tab

messages.author: ecde5087a42c6222
messages.subject: Problem ( RATLLE Down) : Basic of summary type in explore Tab
parts:
Hi, everyone
 
Whenever I excute  Basic of summary type in  explore(tab) , RATTLE is downed.
I have no idea whether my computer problem or RATTLE's problem.
Pls let me know.

Thank you in advance.

messages.author: d6c0ccf22d99409f
messages.subject: Re: Problem ( RATLLE Down) : Basic of summary type in explore  Tab
parts:
Hi,

There is a problem with the fBasics package that causes an error when
running rattle. I just did a test on the audit dataset using rattle
2.3.50, and using an updated fBasics package 260.72 and it worked fine for me.

My advice to you is to update fBasics package, and then run it
separate from the summary option, under the explore tab. If it works
then try running both the summary and basics options under the explore tab.

Regards
Tony
